title: Zinc blende and rocksalt structural properties
action: Implement the Tersoff potential for AgI with the parameters A=207.500 eV, B=36.160 eV, λ=1.8095 Å⁻¹, μ=0.9428 Å⁻¹, n=0.78734, h=-0.57058, β=1.0999e-6, c=1.0039e5, d=16.218, R=3.43 Å, D=0.20 Å, λ₃=0, α=0. Set up a 216-atom cubic simulation cell with periodic boundaries for the zinc blende structure. Equilibrate and collect energy–volume data; fit the Murnaghan equation of state to obtain lattice constant a₀, bulk modulus B, and bulk modulus derivative B′. Extract cohesive energy per atom from the minimum of the fitted curve. Compute elastic constants using a standard method to obtain (C₁₁−C₁₂)/2 and C₄₄. Then set up a 216-atom rocksalt AgI simulation cell. Perform equilibrium MD runs at varying volumes around the expected equilibrium to obtain an energy–volume curve for the rocksalt phase. Fit the Murnaghan equation of state to extract the equilibrium lattice constant a₀, bulk modulus B, and pressure derivative B′. Write all quantities to /app/outputs/zincblende_properties.json, using the keys rocksalt_lattice_constant_angstrom, rocksalt_bulk_modulus_Mbar, rocksalt_bulk_modulus_derivative for the rocksalt phase.
description: Scored artifact containing the computed structural and elastic properties of zinc blende AgI and the equilibrium structural properties of rocksalt AgI, all computed with the Tersoff potential.
output_schema:
{
  "lattice_constant_angstrom": float,
  "bulk_modulus_Mbar": float,
  "bulk_modulus_derivative": float,
  "cohesive_energy_eV_per_atom": float,
  "elastic_C11_minus_C12_over_2_Mbar": float,
  "elastic_C44_Mbar": float,
  "rocksalt_lattice_constant_angstrom": float,
  "rocksalt_bulk_modulus_Mbar": float,
  "rocksalt_bulk_modulus_derivative": float
}

title: Rocksalt phase diffusion coefficients
action: Using the same Tersoff potential, set up a 216-atom rocksalt AgI simulation cell. Run MD simulations under temperature control at pressures 20, 30, 40 kbar and a range of temperatures covering 900–1600 K (at least five distinct temperatures per pressure). For each (p,T) condition, equilibrate and then calculate the mean squared displacement (MSD) of Ag⁺ cations over a sufficiently long trajectory; extract the diffusion coefficient D from the Einstein relation (long-time slope of MSD). Collect all (pressure_kbar, temperature_K, diffusion_coefficient_cm2_per_s) tuples and write them to /app/outputs/rocksalt_diffusion.json.
description: Scored artifact containing Ag⁺ diffusion coefficients in rocksalt AgI at various pressures and temperatures.
